decisions.decision: Any deliberation or action on the future of the Brooks House and T.C. Passios properties would occur only at a properly posted public meeting; the site visit was limited to observations and facts.
decisions.quote: any deliberation or action regarding the future of the properties would occur only at a properly posted public meeting.

decisions.decision: Facilities Director Ruth agreed to provide the cost of the time-and-materials work in the decommissioned area.
decisions.quote: work was performed on a time-and-materials basis because no plans exist, and he agreed to provide the cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Electricity for the food pantry area at T.C. Passios costs roughly $20,000 per year, mostly refrigeration and air conditioning.
budget_items.quote: electricity for the pantry area costs roughly $20,000 per year, driven largely by refrigeration and air conditioning.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Repair estimates for the failed boiler, which failed state inspection over a pressure relief valve, range from $10,000 to $20,000.
budget_items.quote: one is running and has failed state inspection because of a pressure relief valve. repair estimates range from $10,000 to $20,000.

budget_items.topic: Ceiling opening cost in decommissioned area
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Each ceiling opening in the decommissioned area costs about $5,000 because of asbestos in the drywall ceiling compound and cross-connected piping.
budget_items.quote: each ceiling opening costs about $5,000 because drywall ceiling compound contains asbestos, and piping has been cut and cross-connected over the years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Work in the decommissioned area was done on a time-and-materials basis because no plans exist, and Ruth agreed to provide the cost.
budget_items.quote: work was performed on a time-and-materials basis because no plans exist, and he agreed to provide the cost.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Roof work costing over $500,000 triggers ADA improvements.
budget_items.quote: facilities director ruth reported that roof work costing over $500,000 triggers ada improvements.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current estimate to repair the roof portion from the hallway edge to the decommissioning doors is about $750,000, excluding asbestos abatement and roof deck replacement.
budget_items.quote: the current estimate to repair the portion from the hallway edge to the decommissioning doors is about $750,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Work above roughly 30 percent of the prorated full and fair cash value may trigger full ADA upgrades; the building is assessed at $5.4 million, about $2 million prorated, or about $600,000.
budget_items.quote: work above roughly 30 percent of the prorated full and fair cash value (assessed at $5.4 million, about $2 million prorated, or about $600,000) may trigger full ada upgrades.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Anne Nelson said the pantry would expect to contribute financially to any building it occupies, such as the Brooks House.
budget_items.quote: the pantry would expect to contribute financially to a building it occupies.

topics.topic: Brooks House site visit (1033 Massachusetts Avenue)
topics.quote: facilities director ruth reported that the building has been winterized. water and gas are off, and electricity is on only for the fire alarms.

topics.topic: T.C. Passios Elementary School site visit (1025 Massachusetts Avenue)
topics.quote: food pantry area and exterior doors. facilities director ruth reported that the exterior door systems are proprietary, and replacement parts are no longer available.
